# --instructions--

Write a function `sameWord(a, b)` that returns `true` when `a` and `b` are the same word, ignoring letter case and any spaces around them

# --before-seed--

```javascript

const tryCatch = (...args) => {
  _testCount++

  catch (e) {
    _testFailedCount++
    console.log(`Test Case '--err-t${_testCount}--' failed`);
  }
};
```

```javascript

}
```

# --asserts--

`sameWord("Hello", " hello ")` must return `true`.

```javascript
tryCatch(sameWord("Hello", " hello ") === true);
```

`sameWord("JAVA", "java")` must return `true`.

```javascript
tryCatch(sameWord("JAVA", "java") === true);
```

`sameWord("Hi", "Hey")` must return `false`.

```javascript
tryCatch(sameWord("Hi", "Hey") === false);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function sameWord(a, b) {
  return a.trim().toLowerCase() === b.trim().toLowerCase();
}
```
